text_en: Praise the Lord ! O give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; for his steadfast love endures forever.
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 请你们向上主赞颂， 因为他是美善宽仁， 他的仁慈永远常存。

text_en: Who can utter the mighty doings of the Lord , or declare all his praise?
text_cn: 谁能说完上主的大能化工。 谁能述尽上主的一切光荣？

text_en: Happy are those who observe justice, who do righteousness at all times.
text_cn: 遵守诫命的人真是有福！ 时时行义的人，真是有福！

text_en: Remember me, O Lord , when you show favor to your people; help me when you deliver them;
text_cn: 上主，求你为了你对百姓的仁慈，记念我， 又求你按照你施救的扶助，看顾我，

text_en: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory in your heritage.
text_cn: 使我享见你选民的福乐， 因你百姓的欢笑而欢笑； 使我因你的产业而自豪。

text_en: Both we and our ancestors have sinned; we have committed iniquity, have done wickedly.
text_cn: 我们和我们的祖先都犯过罪， 都曾为非作歹而无恶不为：

text_en: Our ancestors, when they were in Egypt, did not consider your wonderful works; they did not remember the abundance of your steadfast love, but rebelled against the Most High at the Red Sea.
text_cn: 我们的祖先在埃及的时期， 对你奇迹的意义总不领会， 也总不怀念你众多的恩惠， 且在红海畔将至高者违背。

text_en: Yet he saved them for his name’s sake, so that he might make known his mighty power.
text_cn: 但他为了自己的名，仍然救了他们。 这是为了彰显他自己的神威大能。

text_en: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it became dry; he led them through the deep as through a desert.
text_cn: 他一呵叱红海，红海立即干涸， 领他们走过海底，像走过沙漠。

text_en: So he saved them from the hand of the foe, and delivered them from the hand of the enemy.
text_cn: 救他们摆脱仇恨者的压迫， 从敌人的手中将他们救回。

text_en: The waters covered their adversaries; not one of them was left.
text_cn: 海水却淹没了他们的敌人， 敌人连一个人也没有留存。

text_en: Then they believed his words; they sang his praise.
text_cn: 他们才相信了他的诺言， 高声歌颂了对他的颂赞。

text_en: But they soon forgot his works; they did not wait for his counsel.
text_cn: 他们很快就忘了上主的作为， 他们不再坚持顺从他的旨意，

text_en: But they had a wanton craving in the wilderness, and put God to the test in the desert;
text_cn: 遂在旷野中放纵贪欲， 在荒芜之地试探天主。

text_en: he gave them what they asked, but sent a wasting disease among them.
text_cn: 上主虽满足了他们的贪求， 却使他们的肚腹发生毒瘤。

text_en: They were jealous of Moses in the camp, and of Aaron, the holy one of the Lord .
text_cn: 他们在营中竟对梅瑟起了嫉妒， 对天主的圣者亚郎也起了嫉妒。

text_en: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the faction of Abiram.
text_cn: 地裂开口吞下了达堂， 掩盖了阿彼兰的同党。

text_en: Fire also broke out in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
text_cn: 有烈火在他们集会中燃起， 火焰就把所有的恶徒焚毁。

text_en: They made a calf at Horeb and worshiped a cast image.
text_cn: 他们在曷勒布制造了牛犊， 竟崇拜了金铸的一个神偶；

text_en: They exchanged the glory of God for the image of an ox that eats grass.
text_cn: 将自己的光荣天主， 变成了吃草的牛犊；

text_en: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,
text_cn: 竟将拯救自己的天主忘记： 他曾在埃及地显示了奇事，

text_en: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
text_cn: 他也曾在含邦施行过灵迹， 他也曾在红海发显过奇异。

text_en: Therefore he said he would destroy them— had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him, to turn away his wrath from destroying them.
text_cn: 若非他拣选的梅瑟出场， 站立在当地裂口的前方， 挽回他存心灭绝的怒浪， 他早下令全将他们灭亡。

text_en: Then they despised the pleasant land, having no faith in his promise.
text_cn: 他们还轻视了福地乐土， 对上主的诺言不肯信取；

text_en: They grumbled in their tents, and did not obey the voice of the Lord .
text_cn: 在自己帐幕内抱怨怀恨， 不愿意听从上主的声音。

text_en: Therefore he raised his hand and swore to them that he would make them fall in the wilderness,
text_cn: 上主于是向他们举手起誓， 要在旷野使他们丧身倒毙；

text_en: and would disperse their descendants among the nations, scattering them over the lands.
text_cn: 要将他们的子孙分散异邦， 要使他们在大地各处流亡。

text_en: Then they attached themselves to the Baal of Peor, and ate sacrifices offered to the dead;
text_cn: 此后他们归依巴耳培敖耳， 还分食祭祀过死神的祭品。

text_en: they provoked the Lord to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
text_cn: 又作恶犯罪触怒了上主， 他忽降灾祸把他们惩处；

text_en: Then Phinehas stood up and interceded, and the plague was stopped.
text_cn: 丕乃哈斯奋起调停， 这灾祸才止息平定。

text_en: And that has been reckoned to him as righteousness from generation to generation forever.
text_cn: 这确算是他的功勋， 世世代代感念不尽。

text_en: They angered the Lord at the waters of Meribah, and it went ill with Moses on their account;
text_cn: 此后，他们在默黎巴水畔激怒上主， 为了他们的原故，梅瑟也连累受苦；

text_en: for they made his spirit bitter, and he spoke words that were rash.
text_cn: 因他们使他精神苦闷， 他唇舌说话未加谨慎。

text_en: They did not destroy the peoples, as the Lord commanded them,
text_cn: 上主命他们消灭异民， 他们却没有听命履行，

text_en: but they mingled with the nations and learned to do as they did.
text_cn: 反而同异民混杂来往， 学会他们的不良习尚，

text_en: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.
text_cn: 竟崇拜了他们的偶像， 偶像成了他们的罗网。

text_en: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to the demons;
text_cn: 他们竟杀了自己的儿女， 把他们奉献给邪魔恶鬼，

text_en: they poured out innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan; and the land was polluted with blood.
text_cn: 倾流了无罪者的血， 就是自己儿女的血， 奉献给客纳罕的木偶， 那地就被流血所玷污。

text_en: Thus they became unclean by their acts, and prostituted themselves in their doings.
text_cn: 他们因自己的作为，全无廉耻， 他们因自己的恶行，行同娼妓。

text_en: Then the anger of the Lord was kindled against his people, and he abhorred his heritage;
text_cn: 为此，上主向百姓大发愤怒， 并对自己的人民憎恨厌恶；

text_en: he gave them into the hand of the nations, so that those who hated them ruled over them.
text_cn: 把他们交在异民的手内， 让恼恨他们的人来主宰，

text_en: Their enemies oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their power.
text_cn: 为他们的仇人所虐待， 在他们的手下受迫害。

text_en: Many times he delivered them, but they were rebellious in their purposes, and were brought low through their iniquity.
text_cn: 上主曾多次拯救他们， 但他们仍是抗不从命， 陷于自己罪恶的深坑。

text_en: Nevertheless he regarded their distress when he heard their cry.
text_cn: 上主听到了他们的哀鸣， 又垂顾了他们受的灾情，

text_en: For their sake he remembered his covenant, and showed compassion according to the abundance of his steadfast love.
text_cn: 忆起了他自己恩待他们的盟约，怜悯了他们， 只因他的慈爱太多。

text_en: He caused them to be pitied by all who held them captive.
text_cn: 使他们在俘掳他们的人前， 成为自己慈爱怜悯的因缘。

text_en: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.
text_cn: 上主，我们的天主， 求你拯救我们，由异民召回我们重逢， 为赞美你的圣名，并以赞美你为光荣。

text_en: Blessed be the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. And let all the people say, “Amen. ” Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 愿上主以色列的天主， 从永远到永远受赞美！ 愿全体百姓齐声唱说：阿们，亚肋路亚。
